test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 17 Oct, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.

My sister Mona / never drinks coffee; / she prefer tea / in the morning.
solution:
The correct answer is '4' i.e. she prefer tea .

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence describes a habitual action.
 
• The subject "she" requires the verb "prefer" to be in the third person singular form, which is "prefers".
 
• The structure of the sentence should be "she prefers tea".

Correct sentence: *My sister Mona never drinks coffee; she **prefers** tea in the morning*.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Subject-Verb Agreement:**

 
 
• **Rule:** The verb must agree with its subject in number and person.
 
• **Example:** He writes (not write) every day.
